# Changes to the data on 2026-11-02, by the WarpX community:
# - Only the neutral atoms and the scalar-relativistic local-density (ScRLDA) column are kept.
# - The occupations are from the ground electronic configuration given in each table.
# - Sm: the ScRLDA column of the NIST table is shifted down by one orbital, as its 1s entry is
#   blank and the 6s value is alone on the line after the 6s row. The values were moved up.
#
# These are density-functional eigenvalues: their differences are the meaningful quantity, while
# the absolute values of outer orbitals are too weakly bound. Do not use them as ionization energies.
#

#   <orbital>:<occupation>:<eigenvalue in Hartree>
